title: Decision: ClientError enum separates cert, parse, and HTTP concerns
description: ClientError (lines 20-30) has four variants: CertNotFound, CertInvalid, Http (delegated via #[from]), and Parse. This structure makes error handling explicit: the caller knows whether the problem is a missing/bad cert (client-side setup), an HTTP status/network error, or malformed JSON. Each variant carries minimal context (PathBuf for cert, String for parse errors). This design avoids lumping all failures into a generic error type.
